notes: Touch screens: a portal on a screen Windows has set up for touch (Tablet PC Settings, Setup; the Corsair Xeneon Edge for one) now takes taps. Before, every tap became an attempt to move the window, so the night control and other taps never…
Omen night mode on a touch screen: tap the portal and the moon appears; tap it for the brightness slider and drag.
The moon and its slider no longer move the window when clicked with a mouse.
